summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Material Change Report and Arrangement Agreement dated April 12, 2026, to acquire all outstanding common shares of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp. via a statutory plan of arrangement under Alberta law. Per SECURE Share, consideration is valued at $24.75 (implied), with an all-cash election of $24.75, a stock election of 0.4195 GFL subordinate voting shares, or a combination of $4.95 cash plus 0.3356 GFL shares. The transaction is structured under Alberta corporate law, making SECURE a wholly-owned subsidiary. Watch for shareholder and court approvals, regulatory clearances, and potential competing bids.
